text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Rickey. Here's a little<n>gift for your
big day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know that feng shui compass of<n>yours needed a
holder, so I made<n>one.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you! You make the cutest<n>things,
Acute! I love how soft and<n>fluffy it is!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmhm, good, I'm glad, dearie. I hope<n>you like the
design too. I sewed the<n>yin-yang symbol myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I tried a method that's quite rare to<n>see. Now what
was it called? Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I can't for the darndest... Must've<n>been "hip hop."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hip-hop? I didn't think that was a<n>sewing style.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's done by stitching different<n>fabrics
together... Hrmm...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, patchwork? You made a<n>patchwork yin-yang
design?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, yes, yes—a patchwork! You're<n>so bright,
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I don't hold a candle to you, Acute!<n>You're too
amazing!
